sources.label: Exophase — official trophy list (names, descriptions, grades)
PSNProfiles — grades and PSN progress targets
PowerPyx — trophy guide & roadmap (difficulty, missable, 100% completion)
planetgta6 — hidden / visible split of the 55

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. Plan for a long haul: PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 at roughly 200 hours, with A Long Road (100% completion) the hardest single step. Nothing needs multiplayer or DLC, and every trophy is offline.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is a story trophy and unlocks automatically — PowerPyx notes it cannot be missed. Just play the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. A story trophy that unlocks when the chapter ends — automatic, and not missable.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. A story trophy that unlocks when the chapter ends — automatic, and not missable. The asterisks in the name are how the game itself prints it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. A story trophy that unlocks when the chapter ends — automatic, and not missable.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. A story trophy that unlocks when the chapter ends — automatic, and not missable.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. A story trophy and the last of the 12 story trophies — automatic once the mission ends. PowerPyx puts the story at five chapters and roughly 60–80 hours.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A story mission trophy — it unlocks when the mission ends, and PowerPyx lists story trophies as unmissable.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission trophy — automatic when the mission ends. PowerPyx places this one in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission trophy — automatic when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission trophy — automatic when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission trophy — automatic when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission trophy — automatic when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — check the in-game 100% Completion checklist after the story; progress made during the story still counts. PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy, but lenient: the checklist is roughly 60% of true completion, and the biggest counts are scanning 200 of 277 vehicles and studying 100 of 255 animals. Do it last, after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts are driving trick moves — jumps, near misses and air time rack them up. Treat it as a background count while you drive everywhere instead of grinding it in one sitting.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample everything the open world offers — races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, meditation and the rest. One of each is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 of them. Learn each range's scoring first, then chase gold one challenge at a time. There are no mission medals to worry about anywhere else in the game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's line, then win them one by one — the count is per location, not per win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races across Leonida and win 20 distinct ones — repeats of the same race do not count twice.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take Cal on at fishing and outscore him. It is one of the earliest trophies players are earning, so it comes up quickly in the game.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet and play one game through to its end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Work through Andy's strand to its last mission. The strand opens during the story — sixshore places its start in Chapter 3, by phone — so if it has not appeared yet, keep playing the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's strand to its last mission. PowerPyx notes some quest givers go temporarily unavailable during the story, Kenton among them, and return later — if he is gone, keep playing.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Work through Billy's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Take on stranger strands as you find them and finish 8 all the way through — the five named strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus Bret's hunt count toward it.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Work through Randy's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work through Tyrone's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations. The one to watch: PowerPyx flags this as the only potentially missable trophy, because the first spot is offered at home in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter. Meditate the first time it is offered, then find the other 17 as you explore.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunt and bring down the unique animal he names. The animal is the point — follow Bret's strand and the hunt itself, not random wildlife.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Collect cards across Leonida and finish three full sets. Cards are a long-tail collectible, so pick them up as you travel rather than hunting them all at the end.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game camera — use it at 100 different spots. Fold it into exploring: photograph each new area as you arrive.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the open world's small goals — 50 of them, across every type. They accumulate naturally if you sample activities; check your challenge list when you are close.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat dies. Do it while your partner is available in the story — partner moments are story-gated.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the heat the whole way — plan a route through three nearby shops and keep moving.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or find 100 distinct vehicles — PSN counts discoveries, so hop into anything new you see. It pairs with A Long Road, which wants 200 of 277 scanned.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a fight with at least five enemies close together and drop all five before it ends. Crowded shootouts are the place to try it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave Vice City International Airport in a way the schedule did not plan — the description points at the airport itself, so look for a departure that is not on the board. The exact trigger is not pinned down by the official description; this guide does not invent one.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos — tanks — in the heat of the moment. The description is a joke, not a checklist: expect a tank encounter in the open world or a mission, and handle it. The exact trigger is not pinned down by the official description.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, go in quiet, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — plan the approach and go at a quiet hour.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get clean away each time — plan the getaway before the job, not after.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop a truck, take the cash, and lose the heat. Trucks run set routes — watch for one, then strike where you can vanish fast.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Visit every named area on the map. Work through it region by region; the map fills in as you go.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find one illegal operation per gang and rob it — nine gangs, nine jobs. The map and your contacts point at operations; the gangs themselves are the checklist.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Order a cocktail at a spot overlooking Ocean Beach and take in the view. It is a flavor moment, not a grind — do it when you are passing.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive out through a showroom's frontage — the description wants the smash, so do it loud. The exact showroom is not pinned down by the official description.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley — the name is in the description, so that is the place. Play a full game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A story-adjacent partnership moment — it unlocks from playing with your partner, not from a grind. Keep playing the story and partner content. The exact trigger is not pinned down by the official description.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices, for better or worse. Choices accumulate across the game — dialogue and action choices both count toward the 500. Just play; it is a volume count, not a single decision.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. Fail something, then clear it on the immediate retry. It is a wink, not a grind — it will come on its own when you retry a failed attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Leonida hides odd sights — keep your eyes open in the open world and something will find you. The exact sight is not pinned down by the official description.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by. Drive past on a bike or in a car and land a melee hit that bowls the target over. A moving melee strike is the trick — speed plus timing.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Fence marked bills through contacts until $250,000 is clean. It is a money goal, not a mission — build it up through robberies and fencing.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in shops of any kind — clothes, weapons, cars and more all count. It accumulates as you kit yourself out; big purchases at the end close the gap.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 of them. Buy every garage on the market. Garages are the long-term money sink; buy them as you can afford them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Photograph or register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app — the in-game app is the tool. It pairs with Whip It Good's 100 discoveries.
